scripts.build:web: VITE_BASE_PATH=./ VITE_API_MODE=direct VITE_FORCE_API_MODE=direct VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://app.rtesp.com pnpm --filter @ryx/web build
scripts.init:android: pnpm run copy:web && capacitor add android
scripts.sync: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run copy:web && capacitor sync android
scripts.apk:debug: pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
